messages.subject: Bootcamps 2014
messages.body_plain:
Final call for participation:

This year, there will be three bootcamps:

- a 4-day bootcamp on statistics for linguists with R (starting from relatively scratch but then aiming to focus on regression modeling) at the University of Mississippi, Oxford (4-7 August 2014).
- a 5-day bootcamp on corpus linguistics with R (frequency lists, concordancing, etc.) at UCSB (11-15 or 16 August 2014);
- a 5-day bootcamp on statistics for linguistics with R (introduction, mono- and multifactorial tests, and regression modeling) at UCSB (18-22 or 23 August 2014).

There are still several places available in the Mississippi bootcamp so if you're interested in taking that bootcamp, plz contact Chris Sapp (<http://home.olemiss.edu/~csapp/ <http://home.olemiss.edu/%7Ecsapp/>>).
We have had declarations of interest for all places in the UCSB bootcamps but not all people who said they are interested have paid yet so if you are interested in a place should they become available, plz contact Stefanie Wulff (<http://www.clas.ufl.edu/users/swulff/>) to be put on a waiting list.

STG
--
Stefan Th. Gries
---------------------------------------
University of California, Santa Barbara
http://tinyurl.com/stgries
---------------------------------------
